description: This file implements a CookieJar class for managing cookies, including serialization, encryption, compression, and encoding utilities. It handles packing and unpacking cookies with cryptographic support and data integrity mechanisms.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: Manages cookies with serialization, encryption, compression, and encoding functionalities.

classes.name: CookieJar::CookieJarPrivate
classes.description: Hides implementation details for CookieJar, including cryptography and packing logic.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Serializes, encrypts, compresses, and encodes cookies into a payload for storage or transmission.

methods.name: Unpack
methods.description: Decodes, decrypts, decompresses, and deserializes cookies from a payload.

methods.name: SetCookies
methods.description: Sets the internal cookie list with move semantics.

methods.name: GetCookies
methods.description: Returns the current list of cookies.
